environment.label: Environment
environment.unknownExplanation: The gateway did not say which deployment it is. Nothing here should be treated as safe to change until it does.
environment.sourcedFromApi: Reported by the gateway this app is talking to, not by the build.

error.invalidCredentials: That username and password did not match. Check both and try again.
error.throttled: Too many attempts from here. Wait a moment and try again.
error.throttledFor: Too many attempts from here. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
error.lockedOut: This account is locked after too many failed attempts. It unlocks once the window passes, or sooner if somebody with the server clears it.
error.lockedOutFor: This account is locked after too many failed attempts. It unlocks in {{seconds}} seconds, or sooner if somebody with the server clears it.
error.notAvailable: This deployment cannot sign you in. Trying again will not help; the server needs configuring.
error.unknown: Signing in failed, and the server did not say why. Check that the backend is reachable and try again.

warning.body: Nothing has been touched for a while, so this session is about to end. Anything you do keeps it.

reauth.heading: Session ended
reauth.body: Signed in as {{name}}. Enter the password to carry on. Nothing behind this has been lost, including anything half typed.
reauth.signOut: Sign out and lose unsaved work

notFound.heading: There is no such screen
notFound.body: The address you asked for does not belong to anything in this back office. It may have been a link from an older version.

list.noMatch: Nothing matches the filter. There are rows here; the filter is hiding them.
list.blocked: Choose a {{names}} to see anything. There is no way to list these across all of them.

reference.missing: This points at {{id}}, which no longer exists.

delete.heading: Delete this row?
delete.body: {{name}} will be deleted. There is no undo, and anything pointing at it may stop working.

discard.heading: Leave without saving?
discard.body: This form has changes that have not been saved. Leaving now loses them.

error.localeTooLong: The {{locale}} text must be at most {{max}} characters.
error.notAUrl: Write a full web address, starting with http:// or https://.
error.tooPrecise: This column keeps {{decimals}} decimals. Values are not rounded for you, because a rounded price is a different price.
error.notAnOption: Choose one of the offered values.
error.notFound: That row is not there. Somebody may have deleted it.
error.forbidden: This account is not allowed to do that.
error.conflict: That change conflicts with the current state. Read the row again and try once more.
error.validation: Some of the values were refused. The details are beside the fields.
error.unreachable: The gateway did not answer. Check that the backend is running.
error.unknown: That did not work, and the server did not say why.

supermarkets.name: Name
supermarkets.externalBrandKeyHelp: The chain's stable identity across discovery runs. It is what splits Carrefour from Carrefour Express, so change it only when that is what you mean.
supermarkets.defaultPriceScopeIdHelp: Set by the catalog service, not from here.

productGroups.name: Name
productGroups.slugHelp: A stable handle for tooling and tests: lower case words separated by single dashes.
productGroups.referenceUnitHelp: The unit this group’s members are compared in. It is the group’s own unit and not any member’s: a group compared in litres can hold a product sold by the pack.
productGroups.synonymsHelp: Separate the words with commas. They are what makes a search for "semi skimmed" reach this group.

items.name: Name
items.categoryHelp: Twelve aisles against a chain’s twenty six, so the mapping from a chain’s own tree is lossy by construction. Correct it here when it is wrong.
items.unitSizeHelp: How many of the unit above are in one pack. Without it the unit says nothing: "litre" is not a size.
items.eanHelp: The only identifier that joins a product across chains, and unique across the whole catalog when present.
items.productGroupIdHelp: Empty is the ordinary state. A freshly harvested product belongs to no group until a person puts it in one.

priceScopes.supermarketIdHelp: A scope cannot move to another chain. That would be a different scope.
priceScopes.kindHelp: How far one price reaches. A warehouse scope prices every shop that warehouse supplies, which is why a price is not attached to a shop.
priceScopes.externalKeyHelp: The chain’s own name for the scope, such as a warehouse code. Text and never a number: it arrives as both 4661 and mad3.
priceScopes.label: Label
priceScopes.labelHelp: For people to read. Most scopes have none, and the kind and the key are what identify one.

locations.supermarketIdHelp: A shop cannot move to another chain. That would be a different shop.
locations.label: Label
locations.labelHelp: For people to read. Most shops have none, and their address is what identifies them.
locations.postalCodeHelp: Changing this does not move the shop to another price scope. The two are set separately, and correcting an address leaves the pricing exactly where it was.
locations.postalCodeSourceHelp: Set by the catalog service. Typing a postal code above records that a person typed it. A shop with no postal code has no source either, which is deliberate: a wrong postcode is worse than none.
locations.priceScopeIdHelp: What this shop prices against. Several shops usually share one, and changing it here moves only this shop.
locations.externalRefHelp: The provider’s own reference, such as node/1156230891. Not a reliable identity: it changes when a shop is remapped.

locationItems.positionInStoreHelp: Where this product sits in this shop, in whatever words help: "aisle 4, bottom shelf".
locationItems.availableHelp: A per shop override, meaning somebody checked this shop. Leaving it unset defers to the price scope, which is not the same as saying the shop does not stock it.

prices.priceScopeIdHelp: A price belongs to a scope and never to a shop. Every shop the scope covers gets this price.
prices.priceHelp: What one pack costs. Typing it here pins the price: no automated run will overwrite it afterwards.
prices.unitPriceHelp: The chain’s own figure, copied exactly. Never work it out from the price and the size: the two disagree on about one product in forty, in the field whose only purpose is comparison.
prices.unitPriceLabelHelp: The chain’s own label for the figure above, in its own words: "100 ml", or "lv" for washing machine loads. It is text and not a unit.
prices.availableHelp: Whether the chain sells this at all in this scope. The per shop answer is on the aisle position.
prices.priceSourceKindHelp: Set when the price is written. A price typed here is pinned, and filtering on "Typed here" is the only way to find every one you have pinned.
prices.priceObservedAtHelp: When this price was last observed. An old date on a pinned price means nothing has checked it since you typed it.

scopeNote.none: Choose a price scope. A price belongs to a scope and never to a single shop.
scopeNote.missing: That price scope could not be read. Choose another one.
scopeNote.coversAtLeast: This scope covers at least {{count}} shops.
scopeNote.warning: Every one of those shops gets this price. This is not the price at one shop.

absent.heading: The harvester does not run here
absent.body: It is switched off in production and in staging on purpose, so nothing is deployed to answer this. Runs happen on a development machine against the compose stack. Nothing is broken and there is nothing to retry.

down.heading: The harvester did not answer
down.body: Something should be listening in this environment and nothing replied. Check that the harvester service and its database are running.

blocked.service-off: Harvesting is switched off on this deployment. HARVEST_ENABLED is false, so no run can start. It is server configuration and cannot be changed from here.
blocked.storefront-off: That storefront is switched off on this deployment. MERCADONA_ENABLED is false, so the run started and stopped before fetching anything. It is server configuration and cannot be changed from here.
blocked.chain-disabled: That chain is switched off. Turn it on under chain sources, which is application state rather than server configuration.
blocked.unknown: The run could not start, and the server did not say which switch stopped it.

switch.heading: What is allowed to happen
switch.lead: Three separate decisions, none of them changed from here. They are shown because otherwise there is no way to tell a run that did nothing from a run that was never allowed to.

what.deployed: Whether the service exists in this environment at all. Set in the Helm chart.
what.harvestEnabled: Whether a running service may start any run. Set in the service configuration.
what.mercadonaEnabled: Whether that one storefront may be fetched. Set in the service configuration.

from.chart: From the chart, which switches the harvester off in production and in staging.
from.reply: Something answered a request on this screen.
from.silence: Nothing answered a request on this screen.
from.refusal: The server refused to start a run and named this switch.
from.run: A run got far enough that this switch must have been on.
from.failure: A run failed and named this switch.
from.nothing: No route reports this, and nothing has been attempted that would reveal it.

start.heading: Start a run
start.attribution: A run's writes are recorded against the harvester service, not against you. Starting one is what is being recorded here.
start.alreadyRunning: A run is already in progress. Only one runs at a time, so wait for it or abort it first.
start.failed: The run did not start, and the server did not say why.

run.aborting: Stopping. The run is flushing what it has already fetched, which is kept, and will finish shortly.
run.paused: This tab is in the background, so the screen has stopped asking. These numbers are from the last read, not from now. Bring the tab forward to carry on.
run.pollFailed: The last read failed. What is shown is from before that.

progress.label: Run progress
progress.unsized: The run does not know yet how much work it has.

places.heading: Discovered places
places.empty: Every discovered place has been decided.
places.why: Nothing in the catalog matched this: neither its OpenStreetMap reference nor the same brand nearby. It is being offered rather than created.
places.supermarketId: Chain identifier to file it under (optional)

near.heading: Others of the same brand nearby
near.none: Nothing else of this brand is near it in the queue.

entries.heading: Source entries
entries.empty: Every entry for this chain has a catalog item.
entries.categoryHelp: The one thing the source does not tell us. Everything else on the item comes from the entry.

choose.body: Entries belong to one chain, so choose which chain to work through. The queue reads that chain's entries that have no catalog item yet.

correct.heading: Point it somewhere else
correct.help: If the match is wrong, give the source's own identifier for the right product. That replaces the link rather than removing it, so the item keeps a price.

sources.heading: Chain sources
sources.lead: How each chain is fetched, and whether it is fetched at all. This switch is per chain and is the one on this screen that can be changed from here.
sources.empty: No chain has a source configured.
